requirement.title: Only team administrators may start new discussions
requirement.explanation: Application behaviour contradicts the requirement. Candidate execution showed that registering with Join Existing Team enabled and an existing team name still lands on the dashboard with role ADMIN rather than USER, so the member persona required by AC-1 is not established. Until join-registration assigns USER correctly, discussion create permissions cannot match the specification.
requirement.source: Team Collaboration - Business Requirements Specification §4.2 Discussion governance

notes: Agent rationale: Creates a team ADMIN via registration with a new team name, then signs out and registers a second user with the Join Existing Team switch enabled and the same team name to represent a USER member. AC-1 opens /app/discussions as that member and asserts the Discussions heading is visible while the Create Discussion control is absent. AC-2 logs back in as the original administrator, opens Discussions, and asserts Create Discussion is visible.
Agent did not report a passing candidate run before submitting.
